comparison.objective: Place a shackle around a towing lug, insert its pin through three aligned holes, and screw it fully home.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual part alignment, close-clearance pin insertion, thread engagement, and repeated rotational regrasps versus loosen/reseat a hex bit and rotate an adjustment collar.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the pin through both ears and lug with its collar within 1 mm of the ear; no response tuning or dynamic stop test. Final screw-pin version has a complete numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Threaded pin assembly through aligned holes is a meaningfully different tested ability, despite shared tool-free rotation and locking.
